title: Repo renamed am-mini-docling -> extrct_docling
summary: Folder and GitHub repo renamed; fixed the fallout (remote URL, venv script shebangs, editable install, worktree paths, stale .pyc co_filename) and the docs.

title: Standalone <stem>.html built on Docling's HTML serializer
summary: Chose to extend docling-core's HTMLDocSerializer (merged-cell tables, captions, formulas) over a custom renderer; added per-block provenance attributes and a JSON manifest for agents.

title: .claude/hooks/lib was never committed
summary: Upstream .gitignore ignores every [Ll]ib folder, so 5 of 6 project hooks crashed on import in fresh clones; re-included with a negation rule and verified from a git archive export.

title: Showcase paper kept in full under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
summary: Added showcase/LICENSE (the repo MIT does not cover it); rejected a page excerpt or a CC BY replacement because the license already allows sharing in whole or part and the paper is in public history.

title: Noise filter hid real echo frames; imaging veto added
summary: Labelled all 68 classifier-hidden pictures in 37 papers by eye: only 6 echo frames were content. A BiomedCLIP imaging type at >= 0.9 (ecg and nuclear_medicine excluded) un-hides exactly those 6 and none of 62 badges/logos.

title: <stem>.html made a full ingestion of the PDF
summary: Docling's serializer left out 7,458 of 10,940 items on 18 papers (figure-internal text, furniture, noise pictures, floating-item footnotes); all are now kept and marked, plus list markers and undecoded formula text. Checked by item coverage (0 missing) and PDF text-layer word recall.

title: Ligature-split words rejoined against the PDF text layer
summary: docling-parse wrote words like 'speci fi city' in 2 of 18 papers; text_repair.py rejoins a split only into a word pdfium reads on the same page, before every export.

title: Granite-Vision table generation had no length limit
summary: max_new_tokens was the tokenizer's unset model_max_length (~1e30); a supplement of boxed prompts read as tables generated for 75+ min with GPU memory climbing 17 -> 57 GB. Capped at max(2048, 3 x crop PDF-text tokens + 512); no real table of 88 came near it.

title: Tables keep their box's PDF text when model cells miss words
summary: Granite-Vision retypes cell text from the image; when cells hold < 95% of the words printed in the box, the PDF text is stored (amir__pdf_text) and shown in the HTML with data-cell-text-recall.

title: Releases named extrct_docling-v<docling version>-r<n>
summary: Replaced the short-lived extrct-v1.0.x tags (deleted on request): tag = fork + upstream Docling base + fork revision; ENGINE_VERSION and run.json engine block (version, git commit, dirty flag) match it. No GitHub Release page: upstream's pypi.yml would fire on the fork.

title: release-tag skill with a sensitive-content scan
summary: Codified the release ritual (version, docs, gates, tag, push only on request) and check_sensitive.sh, which fails a push on never-push files, token patterns, machine paths, username, hostname or private IPs.

title: Releases extrct_docling-v2.131.0-r1 and -r2
summary: r1 (8dd6e035): everything above. r2 (edb3d3a8): HTML keeps captions/footnotes of code blocks (Docling's HTML code serializer drops them) and records html_written_by. Both tags pushed; no workflow ran.

title: 23 sample PDFs converted from r1, HTML written by r2
summary: 4 + 14 papers and 5 supplements: all SUCCESS in one pass, 0 errors; item coverage 0 missing of 12,692; PDF text-layer word recall 99.60-99.82% per batch. HTML regenerated from bundles with r2 (conversion unchanged); outputs are git-ignored under samples/.

title: Adopted the /project-memory ritual from dot-claude-iff
summary: Skill (user-only), CHECK script, retro-analyst agent, push knob, and a UserPromptSubmit hook minting the ritual ticket (approved into hooks.lock); STATUS.md, Project-log.jsonl and LESSONS.jsonl replace AMIR_STAGE's log from here on.

title: Export check scripts were scratch-only and are gone
summary: Item coverage, PDF text-layer recall and the batch watcher lived in the session scratchpad, deleted at the user's request; folding them into amir-batch is the top next step.

title: release-tag gate gains a pre-tag smoke conversion
summary: Retro proposal P1 (confirmed): convert the slowest/table-dense PDF from the working tree into scratch before tagging, with a GPU-memory runaway check, so L-1 is enforced where tags are cut. P2 (L-2/L-3 reminders in release-tag) dropped: STATUS watch-outs already carry them.

title: Release r3: bundle self-check check.json
summary: Every bundle gets check.json (HTML item coverage, PDF text-layer recall per page, export fidelity, ligature splits, degenerate tables, empty chunks) and amir-batch --check-only re-checks bundles.

title: Looping Granite-Vision tables redone by TableFormer; cross-page boxes fixed
summary: A table whose Granite-Vision generation hits its budget or is degenerate takes TableFormer's structure; a cross-page continuation is boxed with its own page height; showcase regenerated from r3.

title: Release r4: watermarks, structure pass, figure-to-data v1
summary: Diagonal watermarks kept out of clusters and reading order; heading levels, roles and caption links in structure.json; figure-to-data v1 behind a flag.

title: Release r5: figure-to-data as a step with three methods, Word and ZIP inputs
summary: Chart-to-data bench rounds 1-5 (docs/mini-bench/chart-to-data/) drove the step design: ollama, cloud and agent methods, the reading model lists the charts and the rules cut from that list; amir-batch takes .docx and .zip.

title: What the r5 bundles lose: tables and text
summary: Three investigations of 88 documents: Granite-Vision made 538 of 546 flagged tables, left printed rows out and misread digits in passing tables; footnotes and in-figure text were in the HTML only; five PDFs had text layers without a Unicode map.

title: Release r6: read a PDF's text through its fonts
summary: Glyph-order fonts decoded exactly into the page's cells, unreadable pages sent to OCR, recorded in run.json quality.text_layer and check.json text_layer.

title: Release r7: tables routed to the model that has their text
summary: TableFormer for tables whose box holds PDF text, Granite-Vision for contents, image-only tables and OCR pages, each redoing the other's failures; OTSL parser keeps a printed '<'; footnotes in markdown and chunks; recommended cloud and local configs of the figure-to-data step.

title: Showcase regenerated with r7 plus the figure-to-data step
summary: showcase/ holds the default, fast and figures-vlm conversions of the showcase paper and the bundle read with each recommended step config (cloud Sonnet 5.5, local Gemma 4).

title: 127-trial batch converted with r7 (no figure-to-data step)
summary: 326 PDFs from 322 files (Word and ZIP included), 16,389 pages in 10.5 h of conversion; two segmentation faults on different PDFs, each converted on the next pass by the job's own retry; amir-batch exit 3 means checks found issues, not a failure.

title: docling-parse 7.20 runs words together and reads look-alike characters
summary: Random and full checks of the 416 bundles found JAMA-style fused words and a Calibri subset read as glyph numbers; pdfium reads the letters right, 7.28 reads both right with defaults, the space factor 0.20 separates words on 7.20 but splits words on a normal NEJM page.

title: Fix each text fault in the layer that owns it; bridge with a temporary repair
summary: Parser faults go upstream (upgrade docling-parse after measuring), PDF faults stay in text_layer.py, the check names residue; r8 carries a temporary cell-level repair so today's bundles are usable; no LLM in the conversion engine.

title: Release r8: temporary parser repair, text_quality check, _docx names
summary: Fused pages decoded again with tighter spacing where that separates words and splits none; look-alikes take pdfium's character by alignment, Greek letters excluded; check.json text_quality names fused, look-alike and unmapped pages against the PDF's own text; a Word-made PDF named like a PDF of the batch is <name>_docx.

title: Bundles r8 changes converted again; transfer zip of the 127-trial set
summary: All 416 bundles inspected; 24 converted again from the r8 tag, figure readings kept; check passes 249->256 and 46->50 on the two trial sets (check.json); residue named per page; the 127-trial set zipped with its sources and a README.

title: Look-alike block first included Greek letters
summary: A Symbol font prints mu from 'm', so taking pdfium's ASCII for a Greek letter would have turned micrometres into millimetres; caught by the check scan over all bundles before reconversion, Greek letters excluded.

title: Batches run from a worktree recorded the input as a file name only
summary: Linked samples/ folders resolve outside the worktree, so public_source_path kept the name; later embed checks skipped page recall and the figure step elsewhere would miss the PDFs; 333 records given their repository path in place, engine fix pending.

title: Progress trigger misread the job's exit codes
summary: The first trigger took 'JOB DONE exit 139' (a segfault) for the end, the next waited for exit 0 while amir-batch exits 3 when checks find issues; HANDOFF now lists 0/3 finished, 1 failed PDF, 139 segfault.

title: Text-quality scripts in scripts/text_quality/
summary: inspect_parser_faults.py lists per bundle the pages the parser repair changes; compare_parsers.py scores chosen pages for an installed docling-parse and its space settings, runnable in a throwaway environment for another version.

title: docling-parse 7.28 fixes the look-alikes, not all fused words, and makes r8's re-decode inert
summary: Measured on four sample PDFs three ways (r8 on 7.20; 7.28 with and without r8's repair): 7.28 reads the look-alike letters right and splits fewer words, but leaves some justified JAMA text joined; since 7.25 it judges gaps in em of a run's own letter spacing, so the DecodeConfig space factors change nothing (joins up to 0.129 em, separates from 0.130).

title: Keep the fused-words repair, rebuilt on the gaps between glyphs; drop the look-alike repair
summary: The plan's keep-and-adapt row: on a line holding a run of 18+ letters a glyph gap wider than 0.06 of the line height becomes a space (word ends measured 0.11-0.15, inside words at most 0), letters never change; the check keeps naming look-alike pages in case a parser regresses.

title: Each bundle draws its own steps: provenance.html and methods.md
summary: Built by a sub-agent in a worktree from the bundle's own records only (run.json, check.json, structure.json, figures.jsonl), reviewed and cherry-picked: phases and cards per step, owner colour-coded (Docling, the fork's patches, the engine), skipped steps with the reason, the steps as JSON for agents; methods.md is a short methods paragraph from a string.Template; amir-batch --check-only writes both for old bundles.

title: Release r9: docling-parse 7.28, glyph-gap repair, provenance files
summary: docling-parse 7.20 -> 7.28 and docling-core 2.98 -> 2.99 (uv pip install, CUDA torch kept); upstream PDF groundtruth regenerated and word-diffed; public_source_path keeps a worktree batch's input path; smoke conversion of four PDFs on full defaults clean; results in the plan's section 9.

title: dgx and the r9 tag pushed to origin
summary: After the sensitive scan (two upstream sample-PDF email addresses already in published test data, the usual commit identity); the remote tag matches the local one.

title: The sample sets carry one-time fixes their records do not show
summary: Besides r8's reconversion of 24 bundles: on 2026-11-20 the figure readings of the r5 bundles were put back into most r7 bundles of the two smaller sets (readings older than the conversion; ran_at is local CET, timing UTC); on 2026-11-25 the worktree path fix of 333 run.json records, and for the 7 r8 bundles of those sets readings put back from r7 and the check run again.

title: A pipeline diagram per release and per one-time fix in each sample set
summary: Four pages at the top of each of the three output sets (pipeline_extrct_docling-<version>[_postfix-<date>].html), drawn with r9's provenance cards from every bundle's records, counts over the release's bundles, one-time fixes as a phase of their own; made by a one-off script outside the repo; the sets are git-ignored and move to their own repo.

title: All sample bundles 'on r8' by r8's check, not by reconversion
summary: r8 changes no text of the 392 r7 bundles (it inspected all 416 and converted again the 24 it changes); reconverting would cost about 13 h of GPU, about 23 GB on a disk with 18 GB free and a docling-parse 7.20 environment, for a superseded release; run.json keeps r7, which converted them. A real reconversion, when wanted, goes to r9.

title: r8's check on 409 sample bundles: every check.json of the three sets is r8's
summary: export_check at the r8 tag, run from the repository root on the shared environment (it reads PDFs with pdfium only; on three r8 bundles it reproduced their check.json field for field). Only checked_by, pdf (bare name -> path) and text_quality changed; its findings are r8's recorded residue; check passes 254/326, 49/67, 17/23 (check.json). Old checks kept in samples/archived/checks_before_r8_recheck_2026-11-27/.

title: Pipeline diagrams drawn before looking up the sets' one-time fixes
summary: The first diagrams showed each release as if its bundles were untouched since conversion; the user had to point at the post-fixes, and the 2026-11-20 carry-over of figure readings was recorded only in a stage-log row. Redrawn with the fixes as their own dated phase (L-8).

title: Running an older release's code on the shared environment
summary: A script file run from the repository root with PYTHONPATH=<release worktree> imports the worktree's docling; python -c puts the current directory first and imports the checkout's. Assert docling.__file__ before trusting the run.
